tagline.en: A 1B vision-language-action policy for dexterous, bimanual manipulation with a 36-DoF action space.
tagline.zh: 一个 1B 的视觉-语言-动作策略，面向灵巧、双臂操作，动作空间为 36 自由度。

en: Dexora 1B is a vision-language-action (VLA) policy aimed at dexterous, bimanual robot manipulation. It reads camera views, robot state and a language instruction, and predicts actions across a 36-DoF action space — enough to drive two-armed, fine-grained control.

It is a 1B RDT-style policy that pairs SigLIP and T5 encoders with a diffusion action sampler, loading weights locally with a strict checkpoint loader. The authors publish data and training code but no official policy weights, so running it requires a checkpoint you have trained yourself (Stage-1 or Stage-3). Training, teleoperation, robot SDK and simulator code are out of scope here.

In WorldFoundry, Dexora 1B runs through the embodied action pipeline rather than video generation: you supply observations and an instruction, and it returns an action trace. Because there are no released policy weights, a locally trained checkpoint is mandatory.
zh: Dexora 1B 是一个面向灵巧、双臂机器人操作的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略。它读取相机视角、机器人状态和一条语言指令，在 36 自由度的动作空间上预测动作——足以驱动双臂、精细的控制。
它是一个 1B 的 RDT 风格策略，把 SigLIP 与 T5 编码器同扩散动作采样器结合，通过严格的 checkpoint 加载器在本地载入权重。作者公开了数据与训练代码，但没有发布官方策略权重，因此运行它需要你自行训练的 checkpoint（Stage-1 或 Stage-3）。训练、遥操作、机器人 SDK 与仿真器代码不在其中。
在 WorldFoundry 中，Dexora 1B 走的是具身动作 pipeline，而非视频生成：你提供观测和指令，它便返回一段动作轨迹。由于没有发布的策略权重，本地训练的 checkpoint 是必需的。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you need a language-conditioned policy for dexterous, dual-arm manipulation with a high-DoF action space, and you have a trained checkpoint to load.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个语言驱动、面向灵巧双臂操作且动作空间高自由度的策略，并且手头有已训练好的 checkpoint 可加载时使用它。

notFor.en: Not a plug-and-play model — the release ships no official policy weights, so you must supply a locally trained checkpoint. It outputs robot actions, not images or video.
notFor.zh: 它不是开箱即用的模型——发布中不含官方策略权重，你必须提供本地训练的 checkpoint。它输出的是机器人动作，而非图像或视频。

SigLIP + T5 encoders with a diffusion action sampler
Requires a locally trained checkpoint — no official weights released
